title: An import blocked by Cloudflare says what to switch off in the Cloudflare dashboard, with folded steps, instead of the manual-install sentence; every other firewall keeps the shared sentence
steps: S1: Run packages/site/tracy-add-site/test/error-next-step.test.mjs: the real ImportWizard starts a read (claim 201, start 202 run-1), and the status door answers the run failed with error 'blocked_by_firewall' and errorDetail {firewall:'cloudflare'}; press the 'How to do it' trigger. Then the same with firewall 'wordfence', 'modsecurity', 'firewall', no errorDetail, and 'cloudflare'. Also call failedRunDetail on runs whose firewall is 'cloudflare', an unknown string, and a number.

S2: Run packages/site/tracy-add-site/test/import-gates.test.mjs: importErrorKey('blocked_by_firewall', {firewall, platform}) for cloudflare, wordfence, sucuri, imunify360, modsecurity, firewall and none, on no platform, wordpress and joomla; and importErrorKey('install_failed', {firewall:'cloudflare'}).
S3: Run the same error-next-step test: ImportErrorText with steps={false}, and the wizard after a Cloudflare failure followed by Back on the connect step.
expect: S1: with cloudflare the alert starts with import_error_blocked_by_cloudflare and does not contain 'install Claude Cowork yourself'; the three steps and the skip-rule note are absent until 'How to do it' is pressed, then present, with three li under [data-cloudflare-steps]. Every other case shows exactly import_error_blocked_by_firewall, no 'How to do it' button and no [data-cloudflare-steps]. failedRunDetail keeps firewall 'cloudflare' and drops the unknown string and the number.
S2: cloudflare maps to import_error_blocked_by_cloudflare on every platform; every other firewall and none map to import_error_blocked_by_firewall; install_failed keeps import_error_install_failed.
S3: the inline red line under the address shows exactly import_error_blocked_by_cloudflare and no [data-cloudflare-steps] anywhere on the page.
evidence: Production: after a manual install of Claude Cowork on a site behind Cloudflare, the engine door still answered 403 cf-mitigated: challenge ('Just a moment...'), so the shared sentence's 'install Claude Cowork yourself' could not help
fence: importErrorKey picks import_error_blocked_by_cloudflare only for blocked_by_firewall with detail.firewall === 'cloudflare'; failedRunDetail keeps errorDetail.firewall only when it is one of the names firewallOf gives

tests: a Cloudflare block names what to switch off, behind "How to do it", and never the manual install
a block by Wordfence keeps the shared firewall sentence, with no Cloudflare steps
a block by ModSecurity keeps the shared firewall sentence, with no Cloudflare steps
a block by an unnamed firewall keeps the shared firewall sentence, with no Cloudflare steps
a block by no firewall named keeps the shared firewall sentence, with no Cloudflare steps
a block by a name Tracy does not give keeps the shared firewall sentence, with no Cloudflare steps
a failed run hands the sentence a firewall only when it is a name firewallOf gives
a Cloudflare block has its own sentence on both platforms; every other firewall keeps the shared one
the inline line under the address keeps the Cloudflare sentence but never the folded steps
